title: CSS Container Queries Demo
description: Self-contained HTML demo from the CSS container queries recipe: one card component adapting to two differently-sized containers, using container-type, named containers, @container breakpoints and cqi units.
description_es: Demo HTML autocontenida de la receta de container queries: un mismo componente de tarjeta adaptándose a dos contenedores de tamaño distinto, con container-type, contenedores con nombre, breakpoints @container y unidades cqi.
